summary: Frontier Nuclear & Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine change in its independent registered public accounting firm. Effective August 24, 2026, De Visser Gray LLP resigned, and MNP LLP was engaged as the new auditor for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2026. The prior audit reports contained no adverse opinions or qualifications, and no disagreements or reportable events occurred. The resignation and engagement were approved by the Board and Audit Committee. This is an ordinary auditor transition, not a special situation; no deal terms or strategic actions are involved.
